note: Deep official-source audit of released reproducibility resources; explicit dimension claims are recorded below.

code.note: Official OpenVLA repository includes model, training, fine-tuning, deployment and evaluation code.

weights.note: Official OpenVLA checkpoints and model cards are publicly released on Hugging Face.

dataset.note: Training/evaluation uses public Open X-Embodiment and BridgeData-style datasets with mixture/config guidance, but the paper's entire training corpus is not packaged as one project dataset release.

training.note: Repository documents LoRA/full fine-tuning and training-from-scratch paths with executable scripts.

inference.note: Public inference and deployment examples are provided, including Hugging Face loading and REST deployment.

evaluation.note: Repository documents benchmark/robot evaluation flows, including LIBERO and BridgeData/WidowX evaluation.

license.note: Repository code is MIT-licensed, while pretrained model use inherits restrictions from the underlying Llama-2 base model.
